task_grounding:
Audacity is open with /home/user/Music/source.wav already loaded (a 3-second stereo 44.1 kHz WAV file).

Export this audio as an MP3 file to /home/user/Music/song.mp3 using File > Export > Export as MP3. In the Export Audio dialog, keep the default bit-rate settings ('Preset: Standard, 170-210 kbps' or similar) and click Save. If an Edit Metadata Tags dialog appears, click OK to accept the defaults.

verification.description: MP3 duration is at least 2.5 seconds

cli_feasibility.translation: 1. cli-anything-audacity project new -o /home/user/Music/project.json 2. cli-anything-audacity --project /home/user/Music/project.json track add 3. cli-anything-audacity --project /home/user/Music/project.json clip add 0 /home/user/Music/source.wav 4. cli-anything-audacity --project /home/user/Music/project.json export render /home/user/Music/song.mp3 --overwrite
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI-Anything-Audacity supports MP3 export via 'export render' command. Stereo WAV files can be imported and exported to MP3 format.
